title: ui_map
description: The in-game map frames: where each client UiMap lies in world yards, for turning world yards into map percent.

map.description: client Map id (continent or instance) the frame lies on

left.description: world y at the map's left edge (x = 0%)

right.description: world y at the map's right edge (x = 100%)

top.description: world x at the map's top edge (y = 0%)

bottom.description: world x at the map's bottom edge (y = 100%)
